openwrt_wiki.Hinweis Hardwareänderung: More recent versions of the WZR-HP-G300NH have had a hardware change without bumping the revision number or changing the hardware label. The newer hardware appears to have the rtl8366rb Ethernet switch while older hardware had the rtl8366s switch. New hardware with rtl8366rb switch is supported in OpenWrt trunk since at least r28133.
openwrt_wiki.Erkennung: For OpenWrt 21.02 and up, ensure the image used matches the switch hardware in the device. The switch can be determined by the model code, printed on a label on the back of the device. The model code is 4 or 5 characters, often separated by a space, located in the top right corner of the label with the SSID on the back of the device.
openwrt_wiki.Code nicht gelistet: dmesg | grep -i rtl8366 in Buffalo Professional Firmware (DD-WRT) oder nach temporärem OpenWrt 19.07
openwrt_wiki.Falsches Image: Installing the wrong firmware image is likely to cause the device to boot into failsafe mode without network support. Recovery per TFTP.
openwrt_wiki.TFTP: U-Boot TFTP-Server 192.168.11.1, MAC 02:AA:BB:CC:DD:1A (bestätigt B0 B0 mit U-Boot 1.06, A0 D0 mit U-Boot 1.07); Client 192.168.11.2; LAN-Port neben WAN über einfachen Switch; Fenster ca. 4 s, öffnet ca. 12 s nach Aufleuchten der Diag-LED; neuere Geräte (HW v2, U-Boot 1.07) nur 1 s, per 'setenv tftp_wait 4' verlängerbar
openwrt_wiki.Gesperrter U-Boot: Neuere (HW v2, U-Boot 1.07) und japanische Geräte: U-Boot nimmt per TFTP keine fremde Firmware; 'setenv accept_open_rt_fmt 1; saveenv' über serielle Konsole (Prompt ar7100>) oder versteckte Wartungsseite cgi-bin/cgi?req=frm&frm=py-db/55debug.html (bufpy / otdpopy+Rootpasswort) mit ubootenv
openwrt_wiki.Fehlerbild: Dauerrote DIAG-LED: Flash fehlgeschlagen oder G300NH2 (A1 A0) -> TFTP mit Buffalo-.enc-Image; langsam blinkende DIAG-LED: TFTP mit tftp-Image
openwrt_wiki.WAN-Port: WAN an eth1 (nicht am Switch), VLAN auf WAN als eth1.<VID>
openwrt_wiki.Wireless: Atheros AR9160 BB/MAC and AR9103 2.4 GHz 3x3 MIMO radio b/g/n

openwrt_git_ath79.Titel: ath79: Add support for Buffalo WZR-HP-G300NH
openwrt_git_ath79.Beschreibung: wireless router working on 2.4GHz band based on Qualcom/Atheros AR9132 rev 2 SoC and is accompanied by Atheros AR9103 wireless chip and Realtek RTL8366RB/S switches. Due to two different switches being used also two different devices are provided.
Specification: 4x LED, 3x button, On/Off slider, Auto/On/Off slider
bare UART header place on PCB
openwrt_git_ath79.Flash instruction: Pay attention to the switch variant and choose the image to flash accordingly (dmesg / kernel logs can tell it). OEM web-gui factory image; sysupgrade; U-Boot TFTP recovery 192.168.11.1 (MAC 02:AA:BB:CC:DD:1A), Client 192.168.11.2, LAN port next to the WAN port via network switch, 'curl -T <imagename> tftp://192.168.11.1', diag light blinks while writing
openwrt_git_ath79.General notes: In the stock firmware the MAC address is the same among all interfaces
openwrt_git_ath79.Unterschiede zu ar71xx: zwei Images je Switch-Variante; Movie-Engine-GPIOs umbenannt (qos_on -> movie_off, qos_off -> movie_on)
